title: Psalms 129
paragraphs: ¹ "They have greatly oppressed me from my youth" — let Israel say — ² "they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me. ³ Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long. ⁴ But the LORD is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked." ⁵ May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

⁶ May they be like grass on a rooftop, which withers before it grows up, ⁷ with which the reaper cannot fill his hands, nor the one who gathers sheaves his arms. ⁸ May those who pass by never say, "The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD."
